summary: Tested booking system enhancements (upcoming appointments, admin booking creation, blocked times CRUD, per-day location, settings for remote message and calendar colors). Backend: 16/16 pytest tests passed (100%). Frontend: All UI elements present and interactive — Dashboard 'Upcoming Appointments' section renders, New Booking modal opens with existing-client search + new-client form, Block Time modal creates and deletes one-time and recurring blocks, Settings page shows Remote Day Message textarea, 3 color pickers, and per-day location dropdowns with Fixed/Remote/Both options.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminBookings.jsx is ~1099 lines — consider splitting NewBookingModal and BlockTimeModal into separate components for maintainability.
BookingController.js is 1255 lines — split availability, blocking, and admin-create logic into service modules.
AdminBookings.createBooking hardcodes status: 'confirmed' even though newBookingData carries no status field — no way to create a pending_payment booking from admin UI (minor UX gap).

BlockedTimesController.list: when neither date_from nor date_to provided but include_recurring='false' is passed, the recurring filter is silently ignored (returns everything). Consider handling include_recurring flag independently of date filters.

Availability endpoint computes slots even on 'remote' days after returning early — OK; but 'fixed' and 'both' both generate the same slots without honoring day-level location — location_type in response is informative only. Confirm this is intentional.
AdminSettings per-day location dropdown is hidden when day is disabled — location_type is retained on toggle but not editable when day is closed; acceptable.
React Router future flag warnings in console (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) — non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: Test blocked times and bookings created via pytest were cleaned up in-test. One UI-created blocked time (TEST_UI_block on future date) was deleted via UI. A prior test block for Sept 8 13:00-14:30 (Lunch break) remains in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_booking_enhancements.py — cover upcoming appointments, blocked times CRUD, availability respecting blocks, admin booking creation, and settings per-day location + remote message + calendar colors. Frontend flow verified via Playwright: login → dashboard upcoming section → bookings page (New Booking / Block Time modals) → settings page (per-day location dropdowns, remote message textarea, 3 color pickers).
